knowledge.text: 訊息大小不等於傳輸線上的位元組數；本課以明定 overhead 的封包模型檢查粒度取捨，避免把 payload 上限混稱任何協定的 MTU。
knowledge.textEn: Message size differs from the bytes carried on a link. Use an explicitly defined per-packet overhead model to study granularity without confusing a payload limit with a protocol-specific MTU.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 產生 packet_id、payload_bytes、overhead_bytes 表；每包 payload 不超上限，合計必須還原原始訊息。
knowledge.textEn: Generate a table of packet identifiers, payload bytes and overhead bytes. Enforce the per-packet payload limit and reconcile all payload fragments to the exact original message length.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 封包數為 ceil(message_bytes/payload_limit)，總線上量為訊息量加封包數乘 overhead；最後一包可不滿載。
knowledge.textEn: Packet count is the ceiling of message bytes divided by payload limit. Modeled wire bytes equal message bytes plus packet count times fixed overhead; the final packet may carry less payload.

steps.objective: 完成「HPC 封包化：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for HPC packetization: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付封包分解、尾包測例與層級定義；標示這是通用帳本，不是某 RDMA transport 完整封包格式。
在交接件中加入「HPC 封包化：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：獨立枚舉 256 與 1024 包；再測 4097 B 訊息，4096 上限時應為兩包而非一包；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：產生 packet_id、payload_bytes、overhead_bytes 表；每包 payload 不超上限，合計必須還原原始訊息。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver packet decomposition, tail-packet cases and layer definitions. Label this as a generic accounting exercise rather than the complete packet format of any particular RDMA transport.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for HPC packetization: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Independently enumerate 256 and 1024 packets. Add a 4097-byte message under a 4096-byte limit and require two packets, checking the boundary where integer truncation would lose the tail. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Generate a table of packet identifiers, payload bytes and overhead bytes. Enforce the per-packet payload limit and reconcile all payload fragments to the exact original message length. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
